messages:
nina: New-onboarding report: some users hitting 401 loops in the Android sample app when backgrounded during token refresh. It retries forever. Anyone seen auth refresh race with Retrofit/OkHttp?

sam: Sounds like the classic double-refresh loop. If two requests get 401, both try to refresh token, one succeeds and updates credentials, the other uses old token and triggers again. You need a single-flight refresh mechanism.

nina: Our SDK uses synchronized block but still saw duplicate refreshes on Kotlin coroutines. Code serialized the refresh but the subsequent request re-enqueued and duplicated.

elaine: Use a Deferred/CompletableDeferred as a refresh in-progress sentinel. If a refresh is ongoing, await the same deferred rather than starting a new refresh. That avoids hammering the auth endpoint.

alex: Also ensure you swap credentials atomically and re-try the original call with the new credentials only once. Too many SDKs blindly enqueue infinite retries on 401. Add a retry counter per call.

sam: Example pattern: 
```
private var refreshInFlight: CompletableDeferred<Boolean>? = null
suspend fun refreshToken(): Boolean {
  val existing = refreshInFlight
  if (existing != null) return existing.await()
  val deferred = CompletableDeferred<Boolean>()
  refreshInFlight = deferred
  try {
    val ok = doNetworkRefresh()
    deferred.complete(ok)
    return ok
  } catch(e: Exception) { deferred.complete(false); return false } finally { refreshInFlight = null }
}
```

nina: Nice. We also had an issue where the auth interceptor replays the request body twice for POSTs because we didn't mark the body as repeatable. Retrofit/OkHttp will throw for non-repeatable bodies.

elaine: Use Buffering or set the request body to be a ReplayRequestBody for retries. Also for large payloads don't buffer; instead fail fast and avoid automatic retry on 401 for non-idempotent methods.

alex: Docs action: add note to SDK about idempotency and automatic 401 retry behavior, show how to opt out for POST/PUT with non-repeatable bodies.

release-bot: release/0.12.4-beta deployed to staging containing auth-refresh-singleflight fix

nina: Will monitor. Also adding unit tests for multi-coroutine refresh scenario and sample app flows.

elaine: Remember to add telemetry that counts refreshes per minute per device to catch regressions early. We added an alert once it exceeds a small threshold.

sam: Another minor gotcha: Android WebView + Chrome custom tabs sometimes share cookies that confuse SDK when using cookie-based sessions. Prefer token header flows in SDK examples.

nina: Good point. Thanks team!
